description: The map light setup. light_modes: per light mode of the map header, the pair of environment presets (indices into config/map_info.json "environments": [flashlight off, flashlight on]) a map starts with; chunk_presets is used instead for an interior with active chunks; any other mode takes default_presets. flash_preset: the preset a flash of light switches to (when bit 0 of the current preset's flags is set); flash_boost: otherwise (bit 1) the spot light grows by this much. light_rigs: where the flashlight and the loading screen's spot light sit on Harry (bone name, the lens flare's bone, position offset in metres, rotation in degrees, intensity 1.0 = normal). Every key is checked. A mod replaces the whole file with its own copy at the same path.
